title: Telluride Housing Authority Subcommittee
location: Hybrid/Rebekah Hall, 113 W Columbia Ave
summary: The Telluride Housing Authority Subcommittee meets October 7 with a mix of housekeeping and a few items that get at the real friction points of deed-restricted housing. First, the Subcommittee will catch up on three months of draft minutes from June, July, and August. The one action item asks for approval of a mortgage exception for Justice Logan James and Mariana Teresa Pereira Vargas, who are under contract on a unit at 1001 E. Wilkin Avenue but need a portfolio loan — a non-conventional financing arrangement — because one applicant falls just short of the two-year employment history required for conventional lending. Staff recommends approval. Two worksessions follow: one on property ownership standards for Amie Martell, and one on the SMRHA lottery timeline for Spruce House H and a status update on Fino Condominiums units 1A and 2A, with a December 11 drawing date on the table. The meeting closes with a presentation of the 2026 Tenant Survey results.

title: Board of County Commissioners Meeting
location: 333 West Colorado Ave, 2nd Floor, Telluride, CO 81423
summary: A full day for the BOCC. On the planning side, two public hearings: one on waiving land use application fees for the Town of Mountain Village's affordable housing project in the Ilium Valley — a question that signals how seriously the county is willing to subsidize the process, not just the construction — and a lot line adjustment for Lots 320A and 320B in the Lawson Hill PUD. The 2027 preliminary budget gets a 90-minute review, which is where the real picture of county priorities comes into focus. The board also takes up a PACCAR Financial lease-purchase agreement, a revised IGA with Ouray County for veteran medical transportation, and two actions advancing the Lawson Hill Connector Trail project — an agreement with the Lawson Hill POA and a CDOT concurrence to award the construction contract. A wildfire mitigation grant letter rounds out the afternoon. Attorney matters include a third-quarter litigation update and a stipulation with Dihedral Fate LLC over a code enforcement action on Lot 4, Avalon Mesa.

title: Town Council Meeting
location: Town Hall, 455 Mountain Village Blvd, Suite A
summary: This all-day special meeting is Mountain Village's annual budget work session — a deep dive into the 2027 budget across every department before formal adoption later in the year. The morning covers general fund revenues, administration, and the capital plan. After lunch, the focus shifts to economic development, the Tourism Fund, the Telluride Conference Center, and planning and development services. Transportation and parking — including gondola and chondola operations — get their own block, as do community grants and parks and recreation. The final stretch is the one to watch: Public Works runs through roads, water, and sewer, and then the Mountain Village Housing Authority walks through the Affordable Housing Development Fund, the Mortgage Assistance Fund, and Village Court Apartments. The session closes with the council acting as board for the dissolved Mountain Village Metropolitan District to address its debt service.

title: Planning Commission Meeting
location: 333 West Colorado Ave., Second Floor Meeting Room, Telluride, CO 81435
summary: The San Miguel County Planning Commission meets October 8 for a session that spans most of the day. The morning opens with a joint work session with the BOCC on an Affordable Housing Code Update — a signal that the county is still actively trying to write policy fast enough to keep pace with a housing situation that hasn't gotten easier. After lunch, the commission takes up a Land Use Code amendment covering Subdivisions and Condominium Plats, which would change the rules governing how land gets divided and how ownership gets structured across unincorporated county. Both items sit at the code-change tier — the kind of amendments that quietly shape what gets built, where, and for whom, long after the meeting is over.
